name: Page review and approval workflow
scope: Remove the replicate right from your client's author groups so their publish requests start the request workflow, and customize it with review, legal or safety sign-off and approval steps assigned to groups, plus an urgent out-of-hours route. Keep the workflows non-transient so their history is saved, create a page version at each publish, and match workflow purging to the agreed retention period.
evidence: A workflow is triggered to notify the appropriate person of your request to publish. This workflow may have been customized by your development team.
source_title: Publishing Pages from the Sites Console

other_pages.title: Customizing Page Authoring
other_pages.quote: Remove the right to the replicate action from all appropriate users for all relevant pages.

other_pages.title: Participating in Workflows
other_pages.quote: If the work item was assigned to a group, the group members are available. If the work item was assigned to a group and then delegated to a user, the group members and the group are available. If the work item was assigned to a single user, the work item cannot be delegated.

other_pages.title: Sites Console Side Panel
other_pages.quote: Note that no information will be shown for transient workflows as no history information is saved for these.

other_pages.title: Customizing Page Publishing
other_pages.quote: Whether a new page version is created upon publish is determined by the location from where you trigger the publish event. To ensure a new version is always created you can use a Cloud Manager Environment variable.

other_pages.title: Administering Workflow Instances
other_pages.quote: Configure Adobe Granite Workflow Purge Configuration to purge workflow instances according to their age and status.

hours_reasoning: Set beside AF07 Review and approval workflows (AEM Forms, 40/80/160), C03 AEM optimization publishing workflow (32/56/96) and A05 Governance and change management (60/120/240). The same kind of AEM workflow build as AF07, with publish permissions and record settings in place of form data; broader than C03's pilot handoff and lighter than A05's governance and change program. Low is one site with one route; high is several sites or markets with routes by section, a legal or safety sign-off and an urgent route.
notes: Adobe's pages cover AEM Sites as a Cloud Service authoring: the Sites console, Page Editor and Universal Editor. Adobe names the request workflow Request for Activation and customizes it with an overlay and the workflow model (Customizing Page Authoring), so the work is code shipped through Cloud Manager. For Edge Delivery sites authored in AEM, aem.live says pages publish from the Sites console's Quick Publish and Manage Publication, so the route is built in AEM and tested on that site. For Edge Delivery sites authored in Experience Workspace, Adobe's Request Publish workflow on aem.live (approvers by path, an approvers' inbox, email through the client's own provider) does this job and is not in this scope. Adobe says Timewarp is not an audit log, so the record rests on workflow history and page versions. Not in these hours: a Universal Editor extension that adds a workflow to its publish flow, email notices from workflow steps (AEM as a Cloud Service keeps email ports disabled until advanced networking is configured), and exporting the record to an external audit service, which Adobe recommends where regulations require uneditable audit logs. Boundaries: A05 defines roles, approvals and the publishing process for Edge Delivery sites and runs Governance Agent checks, while SI07 builds the workflow, permissions and record in AEM. C03 and C05 carry Brand Visibility findings to publishing, AF07 routes submitted forms, AXE01 and AXE02 run reviews through Workfront, SI05 trains authors and AXC07 adds Preflight checks; none of them sets publish permissions or an approval record.

steps: Map your review route by site section with your content owners: who writes, who checks legal or safety wording, who approves, and who covers urgent corrections out of hours.
Remove the replicate right from your author groups, so an author's publish becomes a request, and customize the request workflow with review, legal or safety sign-off and approval steps.
Assign each step to a group, since a single user's work item cannot be delegated, and add an urgent route your on-call approvers can complete out of hours.
Keep the workflows non-transient so their history is saved, create a page version at each publish, set purging to your retention period, and test every route with your reviewers.

method.risk: A page going live unreviewed: we remove the authors' right to publish, so every change, urgent corrections included, passes an approver and leaves a record.
method.outcome: Every page change is approved before it goes live, urgent corrections included, and each published version can be traced to its approval.
